scenes.title: Cracks after the rain?
lines: Every monsoon, new cracks appear in Mangaluru homes.
It's not bad luck. It's water and movement.
Here are 3 fixes we use at Woodland Architects.

scenes.title: Drain water away
lines: One: keep rain away from the foundation.
A sloped apron and a side drain stop the soil under your walls from going soft and sinking.

scenes.title: Plinth beam + DPC
lines: Two: a plinth beam with a DPC.
The beam ties every wall together, and the damp-proof layer stops moisture rising into them.

scenes.title: Mesh at the joints
lines: Three: chicken mesh where concrete meets brick.
They expand differently, so mesh inside the plaster stops those hairline cracks.

scenes.title: Prevent, don't patch.
lines: Cracks are cheap to prevent, and costly to repair.

end_lines: Follow for more smart home design.
caption:
Why do houses in Mangaluru crack after every monsoon? 🌧️ Water and movement, and both can be designed out.

1. A sloped apron and drain to keep rain away from the foundation
2. A plinth beam with a DPC to tie the walls and block rising damp
3. Chicken mesh in the plaster where concrete meets brick
